review_candidates.description: Service Engineer Position Overview The Service Engineer will provide on-site technical support, installation, commissioning and preventative maintenance for CNC machines and related equipment. Acting as the primary field contact for customers, this role focuses on minimizing downtime through rapid troubleshooting, repairs and continuous improvement of service processes. The successful candidate combines strong mechanical and electrical skills with excellent customer communication and a commitment to safety and quality. Key Responsibilities Respond to customer service calls and perform on-site diagnostics, repair and preventive maintenance of CNC machines and ancillary equipment. Install, commission and configure new machines, ensuring correct integration with customer systems and compliance with specifications. Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical and control system faults including CNC controllers (e.g., Fanuc, Siemens, Heidenhain), PLCs and servo drives. Perform routine inspections, calibrations and adjustments to maintain machine accuracy and reliability. Provide clear technical documentation including service reports, spare parts recommendations and maintenance schedules. Train customer personnel on safe operation, routine maintenance and basic troubleshooting procedures. Coordinate with engineering, parts and sales teams to deliver timely solutions and improvements. Manage spare parts inventory for assigned territory and advise on recommended spare holdings to reduce downtime.
